title: Joint petition of B&W Express Corporation (Transferor) and Peter Pan Bus Lines, Inc. (Transferee) for approval by the Department, under the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7A, for the transfer of that portion of Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity No. 3575-C, as authorizes the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain routes in the Cities and Towns of Worcester, Millbury, Shrewsbury, Northboro, Westboro, Southboro, Auburn, Grafton, Upton, Hopkinton, Ashland, Natick, Wellesley, Wayland, Weston, Newton, Framingham and Boston, and on the Massachusetts Turnpike (Interstate Route 90).
